name: Inbound India Equity
simpleDescription: A GIFT City fund that lets NRIs invest in Indian equities in US dollars. Tax-efficient, repatriable, IFSCA-regulated.
proDescription: USD-denominated India equity vehicle for NRIs from GIFT IFSC. Tax-efficient (Section 10(4D)), repatriable, IFSCA-regulated.

name: Outbound Global Equity
simpleDescription: A GIFT City fund that lets Indian residents invest in global equities — US, Europe, EM — without setting up an offshore brokerage.
proDescription: GIFT IFSC-domiciled global equity vehicle. Liberalised remittance via IFSC route, multi-region developed/EM exposure. USD-denominated.
